title: Technology Intern
description: Prepared new Chromebooks for student use by unboxing, installing protective cases, and organizing devices for distribution. Repaired and cleaned previously used Chromebooks to prepare them for continued student use. Organized and managed large quantities of Chromebooks while assisting with the district’s summer device preparation.

title: Technology Intern
description: Assisted the technology department with day-to-day IT operations, troubleshooting, maintenance, and technical projects throughout the district. Worked directly with the Assistant Director of Technology through daily hands-on sessions focused on IT systems, tools, and real-world practices. Gained practical experience with technology administration and support while working alongside the district's IT team.
